title: Ela disse que…
subtitle: Reported speech: contando o que os outros disseram.

can_do.text: Consigo contar o que outras pessoas disseram, perguntaram ou pediram.
can_do.source: CEFR (Conselho da Europa) — Mediação: repassar informações específicas, nível B2

core_inventory: Grammar: reported statements (say / tell + that, tense backshift)
Grammar: reported questions (asked if / whether / where)
Grammar: reported requests and orders (ask / tell someone to do)

guide.title: Reported speech: said, told e asked
guide.intro: Para contar o que alguém disse, use said (that) ou told + pessoa. Normalmente o verbo dá um passo para trás no tempo: is vira was, will vira would, did vira had done.

points.en: "I am tired." → She said she was tired.
points.pt: "Estou cansada." → Ela disse que estava cansada.

points.en: He told me he would call.
points.pt: Ele me disse que ia ligar.
points.note: Tell precisa de alguém: told me, told her.

points.en: She asked me where I lived.
points.pt: Ela me perguntou onde eu morava.
points.note: Pergunta relatada: sem do/did, na ordem normal.

points.en: He asked if I was OK.
points.pt: Ele perguntou se eu estava bem.
points.note: Perguntas de sim ou não: asked if ou whether.

points.en: My boss told me to wait.
points.note: Pedidos e ordens: told/asked + pessoa + to + verbo.

tips: Say something, tell someone. "She said me" está errado: o certo é "She told me" ou "She said to me".
Se a informação ainda é verdade, não precisa mudar o tempo: He said he lives in Rio.

items.en: She said she was tired.
items.answer: Ela disse que estava cansada.
items.why: Said (disse) + was (estava): o verbo volta um tempo.

items.en: Yesterday Tom said he ___ hungry, so we ordered a pizza.
items.pt: Ontem o Tom disse que estava com fome, então pedimos uma pizza.
items.answer: was
items.why: A fala foi ontem e a fome também: said + was.

items.en: She ___ me that she was moving to Canada.
items.pt: Ela me disse que ia se mudar para o Canadá.
items.answer: told
items.why: Tell + pessoa: told me. Say não leva a pessoa logo depois.

wrong.said: Said não vem com a pessoa logo depois. Use told me, ou said (to me) that.

items.pt: Ele me disse que ia ligar.
items.answer: He told me he would call
items.display: He told me he would call.
items.why: Na fala relatada, will vira would.

items.en: Last week Ana said she ___ finished the report.
items.pt: Semana passada a Ana disse que tinha terminado o relatório.
items.answer: had
items.why: Has finished vira had finished quando você relata.

items.en: They said they had never been to Rio.
options: Eles disseram que nunca tinham ido ao Rio.
Eles disseram que vão ao Rio.
Eles nunca disseram nada sobre o Rio.
items.answer: Eles disseram que nunca tinham ido ao Rio.
items.why: Had never been = nunca tinham ido.

items.en: She asked me where I ___.
items.pt: Ela me perguntou onde eu morava.
items.answer: lived
items.why: Pergunta relatada fica na ordem normal (I lived), sem do/did.

wrong.did I live: Na pergunta relatada não há inversão: where I lived.

items.en: He asked if I wanted a coffee.
options: Ele perguntou se eu queria um café.
Ele pediu um café para mim.
items.answer: Ele perguntou se eu queria um café.
items.why: Asked if = perguntou se.

items.en: The teacher asked ___ we had finished.
items.pt: O professor perguntou se a gente tinha terminado.
items.answer: whether
items.why: Pergunta de sim ou não: asked if ou whether (= se).

items.pt: Ela me perguntou quantos anos eu tinha.
items.answer: She asked me how old I was
items.display: She asked me how old I was.
items.why: Pergunta relatada: how old I was (ordem normal).

items.en: I asked him why he was so late.
options: Perguntei a ele por que estava tão atrasado.
Ele me perguntou por que eu estava atrasado.
items.answer: Perguntei a ele por que estava tão atrasado.
items.why: Asked him why he was = perguntei por que ele estava.
Verbos para contar o que alguém disse.

items.en: The doctor told me to rest for a few days.
options: O médico me mandou descansar por alguns dias.
items.answer: O médico me mandou descansar por alguns dias.
items.why: Told + pessoa + to + verbo = mandou fazer.

items.en: My mother asked me ___ the dishes.
items.pt: Minha mãe me pediu para lavar a louça.
items.answer: to wash
items.why: Asked + pessoa + to + verbo = pediu para fazer.

items.en: He told us ___ late again.
items.pt: Ele nos disse para não nos atrasarmos de novo.
items.answer: not to be
items.why: Ordem negativa: told + pessoa + not to + verbo.

items.pt: Ela me pediu para fechar a janela.
items.answer: She asked me to close the window
items.display: She asked me to close the window.
items.why: Asked me to close = pediu para eu fechar.

items.en: He promised he would never do it again.
options: Ele prometeu que nunca mais faria aquilo.
Ele faz isso de novo sempre.
items.answer: Ele prometeu que nunca mais faria aquilo.
items.why: Promised + would = prometeu que faria.

items.en: She explained that the shop ___ closed on Sundays.
items.pt: Ela explicou que a loja fechava aos domingos.
items.answer: was
items.why: Explained + that + frase no passado: the shop was closed.

items.pt: Ela disse que estava cansada.
items.answer: She said she was tired
accept: She said that she was tired
items.why: Said + was: o verbo volta um tempo.

items.pt: Ele me disse que ia ligar.
items.answer: He told me he would call
accept: He told me that he would call
He said that he would call
items.why: Told me + would.

items.en: She asked me where I lived.
items.why: Pergunta relatada: ordem normal, sem do.

items.pt: Perguntei se ela estava bem.
items.answer: I asked if she was OK
accept: I asked if she was okay
I asked whether she was OK
I asked her if she was OK
I asked her if she was okay
I asked if she was well
items.why: Asked if = perguntei se.

items.en: The doctor told me to rest.
items.why: Told + pessoa + to + verbo.

items.pt: Ele me pediu para esperar.
items.answer: He asked me to wait
items.why: Asked + pessoa + to + verbo.

lines: What did Carlos say about the trip?
options: He said he couldn't come because he was sick.
He said me he couldn't come because he was sick.
He told he couldn't come because he was sick.
items.answer: He said he couldn't come because he was sick.
items.pt: Ele disse que não podia vir porque estava doente.
items.why: Said + frase, ou told + pessoa. "Said me" e "told he" estão errados.

options: Yes, she asked if we could send the documents today.
Yes, she asked if could we send the documents today.
Yes, she asked do we can send the documents today.
items.answer: Yes, she asked if we could send the documents today.
items.pt: Sim, ela perguntou se a gente podia mandar os documentos hoje.
items.why: Pergunta relatada: asked if + ordem normal (we could).

lines: Why are you taking the bus today?
options: My dad told me not to use his car.
My dad told me don't use his car.
My dad said me not to use his car.
items.answer: My dad told me not to use his car.
items.pt: Meu pai me disse para não usar o carro dele.
items.why: Ordem negativa: told me not to + verbo.

items.en: She told me she was moving.
items.pt: Ela me disse que ia se mudar.
items.why: "Told" tem o L leve e o d no fim: "tôuld".

items.en: He asked me where I lived.
items.pt: Ele me perguntou onde eu morava.
items.why: "Asked" soa "ÉSKT", tudo junto.

lines: Did you give Paula my message?
options: Yes, I told her you would call tonight.
Yes, I told her you will called tonight.
Yes, I said her you would call tonight.
items.answer: Yes, I told her you would call tonight.
items.pt: Sim, eu disse a ela que você ia ligar hoje à noite.
items.why: Told her + would call.

items.en: He asked me what time the film ___.
items.pt: Ele me perguntou a que horas o filme começava.
items.answer: started
items.why: Pergunta relatada sem do/did: what time the film started.

items.pt: Ela me disse para não me preocupar.
items.answer: She told me not to worry
items.why: Told + pessoa + not to + verbo.

items.en: They complained that the room was too small.
options: Eles reclamaram que o quarto era pequeno demais.
items.answer: Eles reclamaram que o quarto era pequeno demais.
items.why: Complain = reclamar.

items.en: Laura ___ that she had lost her keys.
items.pt: A Laura comentou que tinha perdido as chaves.
items.answer: mentioned
items.why: Mentioned that = mencionou que. Told precisaria de alguém (told me).

items.en: He promised he would help me.
items.why: Promised + would = prometeu que faria.

items.en: I asked if she was OK.
items.pt: Perguntei se ela estava bem.
items.why: "If she" se liga na fala: "if-xi".

lines.en: Hi, Ben! Did anyone call while I was out?
lines.pt: Oi, Ben! Alguém ligou enquanto eu estava fora?

lines.en: Yes, your mother called. She ___ me she would visit us on Saturday.
lines.pt: Sim, sua mãe ligou. Ela me disse que viria nos visitar no sábado.

lines.ask: Quando a mãe da Sofia vem visitar?

lines.en: And a man from the bank asked ___ you could call him back.
lines.pt: E um homem do banco perguntou se você poderia ligar de volta para ele.

lines.en: Did he say what it was about?
lines.pt: Ele disse do que se tratava?

lines.en: No, he just told me it was important.
lines.pt: Não, ele só me disse que era importante.

lines.en: Oh, and Leo asked me ___ you about the party.
lines.pt: Ah, e o Leo me pediu para te lembrar da festa.

lines.en: The party! I completely forgot. What time did he say?
lines.pt: A festa! Esqueci completamente. Que horas ele disse?

lines.en: He said it started at eight, and he asked us not to be late.
lines.pt: Ele disse que começava às oito e pediu para a gente não se atrasar.

lines.why: "he asked us not to be late".

items.why: Histórias mostram o inglês em uso de verdade. Ouça cada fala, complete as lacunas e responda às perguntas no caminho.

items.answer: Um homem
items.why: "a man from the bank".

items.q: O que o homem do banco disse?
items.answer: Que era importante
items.why: "he just told me it was important".

items.q: A que horas começa a festa?
items.answer: Às oito
items.why: "He said it started at eight".
